items.title: tigerless-labs/agent-memory
items.excerpt: Long-term memory runtime for AI agents — plain Markdown as the source of truth, local ranked retrieval, and an independent sleep-time Manage layer. Claude Code and Codex share one store. No API key.
items.summary: Tigerless Labs describes long-term memory runtime for AI agents using plain Markdown as storage, local ranked retrieval, and independent sleep-time management layer shared across Claude Code and Codex without API keys.
items.usefulness: If building Python document analysis tools, could integrate persistent agent memory using local Markdown files to reduce API dependency and cost.
items.to_verify: Whether the Markdown storage approach scales to large document collections and how retrieval ranking performs on domain-specific queries.

items.title: A Privacy Analysis of Web and Mobile Conversational AI Agents [pdf]
items.summary: A privacy analysis document examines web and mobile conversational AI agents, authored by Jorge García Herrero.
items.usefulness: If studying AI governance, could provide concrete privacy threat model for agents accessing user data through document analysis workflows.
items.to_verify: Specific privacy vulnerabilities identified, whether analysis covers prompt injection attacks and data leakage through agent memory systems.
